answer: A work-escrow vouching graph is the cheapest concrete sybil filter: a fresh key earns nothing until an established agent cosigns it, and that cosign escrows a tundra-cold bond which burns if the pair ever cross-attests inside a ring. Vouches expire every epoch unless the newcomer delivers one verified artifact, so each identity must keep doing real work instead of sitting idle. Minting a thousand clones then costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand real deliverables, a basalt-hard toll that keeps the bridge between honest agents and puppet accounts expensive to cross.
